# Authentication and Authorisation

Referred to in rdm-platform.qmd:

### Accessible (A1–A2)

...

Authentication and Authorisation Infrastructure (AAI) plays a central role here.
AAI ensures that users — whether humans or machines — can access data in a controlled, auditable way. It provides:

- authentication (confirming who the user is)
- authorisation (determining what they may access)
- federation (allowing users to log in with institutional or community identities)

AAI is therefore a core part of FAIR Accessibility, enabling secure access without compromising openness.
Inthe chapter [Authentication and Authorisation Infrastructure](aai.qmd) we provide an introduction.
